note: No external organisation has adopted, endorsed or partnered with HPI. The adoption and partnership registers are empty by design and can only accept entries with verifiable public evidence.

maturityLevels.title: Evidence reviewed
maturityLevels.definition: Relevant evidence assessed, with limitations stated.
maturityLevels.evidenceRequired: Published evidence review; state whether internal or independent.

maturityLevels.title: Evaluation ready
maturityLevels.definition: Protocol and prerequisites specified; approvals may still be pending.
maturityLevels.evidenceRequired: Published protocol with comparator, estimand, power and named gates.

maturityLevels.title: Independently evaluated
maturityLevels.evidenceRequired: Evaluation report by an evaluator independent of HPI.

maturityLevels.title: Replication assessed
maturityLevels.evidenceRequired: Independent evidence from at least one further context.

maturityLevels.title: Adopted
maturityLevels.definition: Actual, independently evidenced use by an external organisation.
maturityLevels.evidenceRequired: Verifiable public evidence of use by the adopting organisation.

readinessDimensions.title: Legal and regulatory compatibility
questions: Is there a legally accountable operator?
Is the activity permitted under local law and programme rules?
Is any data processing lawful, with a named controller?

readinessDimensions.title: Institutional feasibility
questions: Does the administering agency support the activity where its processes are involved?
Is there capacity to deliver without displacing existing services?

readinessDimensions.title: Language and accessibility
questions: Are materials available in the languages people use?
Are non-digital and accessible channels available?

readinessDimensions.title: Local data availability
questions: Is the primary outcome measurable from lawful sources?
Is a verified local denominator available?

readinessDimensions.title: Scientific transferability
questions: Does the mechanism plausibly operate here, with documented evidence?
Which local differences could change the effect?

readinessDimensions.title: Costs and resources
questions: Is funding secured for the full follow-up?

readinessDimensions.title: Ethics, privacy and safeguarding
questions: Has an independent ethics body reviewed the design?
Is there a staffed safeguarding and confidential reporting route?
readinessDimensions.specialistReview: Independent ethics committee and safeguarding lead

readinessDimensions.title: Human capacity
questions: Are trained staff available for delivery, supervision and data handling?

readinessDimensions.title: Measurement feasibility
questions: Can verified receipt (or the relevant primary outcome) be observed at follow-up?
Can harms and equity gaps be measured?
